structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Modes of Transportation: Highways, Bridges, Ferries, Rail, and Public Transportation
High-Occupancy Vehicle Lanes and High-Occupancy Toll Lanes

law.catch_line: Exclusion of HOT lanes from certain other laws
law.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the provisions of §§ 22.1-187, 33.2-501, 33.2-613, 46.2-819, and 46.2-819.1 shall not apply to HOT lanes.
